name: io.github.wyre-technology/kpn-mcp
title: KPN
description: MCP server for KPN: outage checks, address availability, SIM swap and business mobile (MSM).

environmentVariables.name: KPN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: KPN API Store project client ID (developer.kpn.com → Dashboard → Projects)

environmentVariables.name: KPN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: KPN API Store project client secret

environmentVariables.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional customer GRIP-bound Mobile Services Management app ID (falls back to KPN_CLIENT_ID)

environmentVariables.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional MSM app secret; must be set together with KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: KPN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: KPN API base URL (env mode only)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
